generation.prompt:
A clean, high-fidelity website homepage mockup for a university Electrical Engineering department, displayed in a browser window frame. Minimal institutional design, sharp 4px border-radius throughout (not rounded pills). Color palette: off-white paper background (#f7f9fb), deep ink-navy text (#0b1220), copper/burnt-orange accent color (#b5622a) for buttons and links, thin light-gray hairline borders (#dde3e8), small teal tag accents (#1c6e6e). Inter sans-serif typography, left-aligned headings, bold display headline.

Layout top to bottom:
1. Sticky white top navigation bar with a small geometric logo mark on the left, center nav links 'Home About People Research Seminars Companies Contact', thin bottom hairline border.
2. Hero section: left side has small uppercase copper eyebrow label 'DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING', large bold navy headline 'Engineering the Future of Power, Circuits & Intelligence', a gray subheading sentence below, a filled copper rectangular button 'Explore Research' and an outlined ghost button 'Meet the Faculty' side by side. Right side of hero has an abstract low-poly 3D wireframe illustration of a rotating microchip/circuit board mesh in copper and teal line strokes, floating on the paper background with a soft shadow beneath it suggesting gentle 3D depth.
3. Below hero: a 'Latest News' section with a copper eyebrow label, bold heading, and three flat white rectangular cards in a row, each with a small date tag, bold title, two lines of gray description text, and a small teal category tag pill, all cards separated by thin hairline borders with no drop shadow.
4. A two-column 'From the Head of Department' section: left a circular portrait placeholder, right a short welcome paragraph and a copper text link 'Read Full Message with an arrow'.
5. A 'Research Areas' section showing three side-by-side flat panels labeled 'Power Engineering', 'VLSI & Microelectronics', 'Signal Processing & Communication', each with a simple abstract line icon.
6. Footer: full-width dark ink-navy band with white text, three columns of links, and small social icons row.

Overall mood: professional, academic, minimal, engineering-blueprint feel, generous whitespace, sharp corners, no gradients except the subtle 3D hero illustration.
